en_meaning: A small waterfall or a large amount of something falling together
vi_meaning: Thác nước; chuỗi dồn dập, sự đổ dồn
example_sentence: A sudden failure in the subprime mortgage market triggered a cascade of financial insolvencies that quickly rippled across global banking institutions.

en_meaning: To reprimand or punish someone severely
vi_meaning: Trừng phạt, khiển trách gay gắt
example_sentence: In his blistering editorial, the investigative journalist castigated municipal authorities for turning a blind eye to widespread industrial contamination.

en_meaning: A person killed or injured in a war or accident
vi_meaning: Thương vong, nạn nhân; tổn thất
example_sentence: Although the battle resulted in surprisingly few military casualties, civilian infrastructure suffered catastrophic damage that required decades of reconstruction.

en_meaning: A large-scale and violent event in the natural world
vi_meaning: Đại hồng thủy; biến cố địa chất hoặc xã hội dữ dội
example_sentence: Paleontologists hypothesize that the Cretaceous extinction was precipitated by an extraterrestrial cataclysm that obscured sunlight and collapsed marine food webs.

en_meaning: To hurl or launch something in a specified direction
vi_meaning: Phóng mạnh, đẩy vọt lên
example_sentence: The unexpected commercial success of her debut novel catapulted the recluse author into the dazzling spotlight of international literary acclaim.

en_meaning: A large waterfall or a medical condition where the eye lens becomes cloudy
vi_meaning: Thác nước lớn; bệnh đục thủy tinh thể
example_sentence: Before modern surgical interventions were developed, an untreated cataract would inexorably cloud the lens of the human eye until complete blindness ensued.

en_meaning: Excessively polite or formal; following strict rituals
vi_meaning: Trịnh trọng, kiểu cách, câu nệ nghi thức
example_sentence: The ambassador greeted the visiting plenipotentiaries with ceremonious formality, observing every punctilio prescribed by court etiquette.

en_meaning: An event causing great and usually sudden damage or suffering; a disaster
vi_meaning: Thảm họa, tai ương khốc liệt
example_sentence: The sudden breach of the earthen dam precipitated an ecological catastrophe, engulfing fragile riparian wetlands in millions of gallons of toxic residue.

en_meaning: A loud, sexually suggestive whistle or comment directed at someone
vi_meaning: Tiếng la ó phản đối, tiếng huýt sáo châm chọc
example_sentence: As the controversial speaker took the podium, his opening remarks were momentarily drowned out by derisive catcalls from the hostile auditorium.

en_meaning: A summary of religious doctrine often in the form of questions and answers
vi_meaning: Sách giáo lý vấn đáp; hệ nguyên lý căn bản
example_sentence: Reared in the austere puritanical schoolhouse, the young pupils were compelled to recite every article of the theological catechism from memory.

en_meaning: Unambiguously explicit and direct; absolute and without exceptions
vi_meaning: Tuyệt đối, khẳng định dứt khoát, không điều kiện
example_sentence: Confronted with allegations of corruption, the cabinet minister issued a categorical denial, asserting that no public funds had been misappropriated.

en_meaning: To provide food, services, or entertainment for a specific group or need
vi_meaning: Phục vụ nhu cầu, chiều theo
example_sentence: Critics lamented that the news network increasingly catered to sensationalism rather than providing sober, analytical coverage of international crises.

en_meaning: The process of releasing strong or repressed emotions through a particular experience
vi_meaning: Sự thanh lọc tâm hồn, sự giải tỏa cảm xúc
example_sentence: Aristotle argued that dramatic tragedy purges the audience of pity and terror, achieving an emotional catharsis that restores psychological equilibrium.

en_meaning: Broad or wide-ranging in tastes, interests, or specialized areas
vi_meaning: Rộng rãi, bao quát, đa dạng nhiều lĩnh vực
example_sentence: Blessed with catholic intellectual curiosity, the Renaissance polymath authored foundational treatises in fields as disparate as botany, optics, and theology.

en_meaning: A meeting of members of a political party to choose candidates or decide policy
vi_meaning: Cuộc họp kín nội bộ đảng chính trị
example_sentence: Behind the closed doors of the party caucus, rival factions engaged in intense horse-trading to secure delegate votes before the primary.

en_meaning: To seal gaps or seams to make them watertight or airtight
vi_meaning: Trét kín, xảm kín khe hở chống thấm
example_sentence: Before embarking on the transatlantic voyage, the shipwrights meticulously caulked the seams of the wooden schooner with oakum and heated pitch.

en_meaning: Relating to or acting as a cause
vi_meaning: Thuộc quan hệ nhân quả
example_sentence: Epidemiologists emphasized that observing a strong statistical correlation between dietary habits and disease incidence does not inherently establish a causal relationship.

en_meaning: Able to burn or corrode by chemical action; sarcastic in a scathing way
vi_meaning: Ăn mòn hóa học; châm chọc cay độc
example_sentence: The drama critic was renowned for her caustic wit, often eviscerating pretentious Broadway productions with a few sharply turned phrases.

en_meaning: A formal procession of people walking, on horseback, or in vehicles
vi_meaning: Đoàn người hoặc xe diễu hành trang trọng
example_sentence: A colorful cavalcade of equestrian performers, musicians, and heralds wound its way through the cobbled streets during the annual harvest festival.

en_meaning: Showing a lack of proper concern; dismissive or arrogant
vi_meaning: Khinh khỉnh, coi thường, bừa bãi thiếu cẩn trọng
example_sentence: Environmental regulators penalized the chemical manufacturer for its cavalier attitude toward hazardous waste disposal, citing repeated safety violations.

en_meaning: To make petty or unnecessary objections
vi_meaning: Bắt bẻ vô lý, soi mói chuyện vụn vặt
example_sentence: Rather than addressing the substantive constitutional issues raised by the reform bill, opponents chose to cavil over minor syntactic ambiguities in its preamble.

en_meaning: To give up power or territory, often by treaty
vi_meaning: Nhượng lại, giao nộp quyền lực hoặc lãnh thổ
example_sentence: Under the terms of the 1848 treaty, the defeated empire was coerced to cede vast swaths of its northern territories to its encroaching neighbor.

en_meaning: Well known and widely admired or respected
vi_meaning: Lừng danh, nổi tiếng và được tôn vinh
example_sentence: The celebrated ornithologist dedicated her life to cataloging endangered raptor populations across the mountainous wilderness of Central Asia.

en_meaning: Swiftness of movement; speed
vi_meaning: Sự mau lẹ, tốc độ nhanh chóng
example_sentence: Recognizing the imminent threat of flooding, the corps of engineers fortified the crumbling levee with commendable celerity.

en_meaning: Positioned in or relating to the sky, or outer space
vi_meaning: Thuộc về bầu trời, thiên thể; thần thánh
example_sentence: Without magnetic compasses or landmarks, early Polynesian navigators charted their oceanic voyages by observing the nightly trajectories of celestial bodies.

en_meaning: Abstaining from marriage and sexual relations, typically for religious reasons
vi_meaning: Độc thân, tiết dục, kiêng quan hệ tình dục
example_sentence: The monastic order required its members to take a solemn vow of poverty, obedience, and a celibate lifestyle dedicated entirely to religious contemplation.

en_meaning: An official who examines material to suppress unacceptable parts
vi_meaning: Nhân viên kiểm duyệt
example_sentence: During wartime, the military censor systematically redacted sensitive tactical information and coordinates from soldiers' correspondence home.

en_meaning: Severely critical of others
vi_meaning: Hay chỉ trích, khắt khe săm soi
example_sentence: In her letters to her sister, Jane Austen gently satirized the censorious neighbors who scrutinized everyone's moral conduct while overlooking their own hypocrisies.

en_meaning: Strong expression of disapproval or official rebuke
vi_meaning: Sự chỉ trích nghiêm khắc, lời khiển trách chính thức
example_sentence: The rogue intelligence analyst faced severe legislative censure after leaking classified documents regarding surveillance operations to the international press.

en_meaning: A scale of temperature measurement where water freezes at 0 and boils at 100
vi_meaning: Bách phân, thang nhiệt độ Celsius
example_sentence: In their laboratory report, the physical chemists documented that the compound decomposed rapidly when ambient temperatures surpassed forty degrees centigrade.

en_meaning: Moving or tending to move toward a center
vi_meaning: Hướng tâm, có xu hướng hút về tâm
example_sentence: In classical mechanics, the centripetal force exerted by gravity maintains planets in stable elliptical orbits around the sun.

en_meaning: An officer in the ancient Roman army commanding a group of one hundred soldiers
vi_meaning: Bách nhân đội trưởng La Mã
example_sentence: Excavations at the Roman garrison revealed a funerary monument erected in honor of a centurion who had commanded a century of the Tenth Legion.

en_meaning: Relating to the brain or intellect rather than emotions
vi_meaning: Thuộc về não bộ; thiên về lý trí và trí tuệ
example_sentence: While traditional espionage thrillers rely on kinetic combat, the author's cerebral novel focused instead on the psychological chess match between rival decoders.

en_meaning: The act of thinking or using one's mind
vi_meaning: Hoạt động tư duy, sự vận dụng trí óc
example_sentence: Deciphering the encrypted cuneiform tablets required months of intense cerebration and comparative philological analysis by an international team of scholars.

en_meaning: Absolute certainty or conviction that something is true
vi_meaning: Sự tin chắc tuyệt đối, sự đoan chắc
example_sentence: Despite widespread skepticism among his peers, the astronomer defended his unorthodox planetary model with unshakeable certitude.

en_meaning: The process of ending or being brought to a stop
vi_meaning: Sự đình chỉ, sự chấm dứt hoàn toàn
example_sentence: A temporary cessation of hostilities was brokered to allow the Red Cross to deliver emergency rations and medical supplies to trapped noncombatants.

en_meaning: The formal giving up of rights, property, or territory
vi_meaning: Sự nhượng lại quyền lợi hoặc lãnh thổ theo hòa ước
example_sentence: The territorial cession stipulated by the armistice redrew national boundaries and displaced thousands of indigenous inhabitants along the frontier.

en_meaning: To make sore by rubbing against something; to feel irritation
vi_meaning: Trầy xước do cọ xát; bứt rứt, khó chịu vì bị gò ép
example_sentence: Rebellious colonists began to chafe under the onerous maritime tariffs and quartering acts imposed by Parliament without colonial representation.

en_meaning: The husks of corn or other seed separated by winnowing
vi_meaning: Vỏ trấu; đồ vô giá trị, rác rưởi bị loại bỏ
example_sentence: An astute investigative reporter must learn to discard misleading public relations chaff and focus strictly on substantiated financial records.

en_meaning: The act of teasing someone in a lighthearted, mocking way
vi_meaning: Sự trêu chọc thân mật, lời giễu cợt hài hước
example_sentence: Beneath the relentless intellectual chaffing between the two senior professors lay a profound mutual respect developed over three decades of collaboration.

en_meaning: Distress or embarrassment at having failed or been humiliated
vi_meaning: Nỗi thất vọng ê chề, sự bực bội vì bẽ mặt
example_sentence: Much to the chagrin of the incumbent prime minister, an unforeseen scandal caused his coalition to collapse just weeks before the general election.

en_meaning: A large cup or goblet, typically used for drinking wine in Christian rituals
vi_meaning: Chén thánh, cốc tế lễ
example_sentence: During the medieval communion liturgy, the priest elevated the silver chalice containing sacramental wine before the kneeling congregation.

en_meaning: A lizard that changes color; a person who changes their behavior to please others
vi_meaning: Tắc kè hoa; kẻ cơ hội dễ dàng đổi phe
example_sentence: Historians often describe the foreign minister as an opportunistic chameleon who adeptly altered his ideological commitments to survive three successive regime changes.

en_meaning: A person who has defeated all rivals; to vigorously support a cause
vi_meaning: Tích cực ủng hộ, bảo vệ và đấu tranh cho
example_sentence: Throughout her legislative career, the senator championed landmark environmental legislation designed to protect old-growth forests from commercial logging.

en_meaning: Compelling attractiveness or charm that can inspire devotion in others
vi_meaning: Sức hút cá nhân, uy tín lôi cuốn quần chúng
example_sentence: The populist leader possessed an electrifying charisma that magnetized disenfranchised voters and galvanized mass rallies across the nation.

en_meaning: A person falsely claiming to have a special knowledge or skill; a fraud
vi_meaning: Kẻ bịp bợm, kẻ giả danh chuyên môn, lang băm
example_sentence: The 19th-century patent medicine salesman was eventually unmasked as a charlatan whose miraculous panacea was merely tainted well water and grain alcohol.

en_meaning: Cautiously or suspiciously reluctant to do something
vi_meaning: Thận trọng dè dặt, cảnh giác
example_sentence: Having suffered catastrophic losses during the previous market collapse, venture capitalists were exceedingly chary about investing in unproven artificial intelligence startups.

en_meaning: A deep fissure in the earth, rock, or another surface; a profound difference
vi_meaning: Vực sâu, hẻm núi sâu; sự chia rẽ sâu sắc
example_sentence: The ideological chasm separating the two political parties has steadily widened, paralyzing congressional negotiations on fiscal reform.

en_meaning: The base frame of a motor vehicle or other wheeled object
vi_meaning: Khung gầm xe, bệ khung chịu lực
example_sentence: Engineers reinforced the vehicle's tubular steel chassis to withstand the brutal torsional stresses encountered on off-road terrain.

en_meaning: Abstaining from extramarital, or from all, sexual intercourse; simple and unadorned
vi_meaning: Trong trắng, tiết hạnh; giản dị mộc mạc
example_sentence: Rejecting the gilded extravagances of Rococo decor, the architect adopted a chaste, austere aesthetic characterized by clean geometric lines and unadorned limestone.
